objective:
Research only. Find where the 0.12 between this network's paradigm.xyz/puzzles/amm entry (QLX5, 528.3333, 4th) and #1 (528.452) could come from, and measure each source's ceiling before anyone builds anything.
Base: QLX5, Taylor (gtmcknight)'s solved policy (github.com/gtmcknight/amm-sim at 4812a6382311624e1506aca131ca35c378f930d9 research/solved) plus network extensions; source sha256 e183e5bc3fb794b7067703b10a7da9920267aa5f4caa968e16ca101b02338f40 in https://api.imd.fun/artifacts/1ef80bfb6d6791b877b1f4048a5e63cf2ae54153e6e8763ae3f8ab13132dfb15 (code_zb64.QLX5). Credit Taylor in every file.
Tools: the engine-faithful replica (equal to the engine within its printed precision on 512 seeds): https://api.imd.fun/artifacts/a1eef2f3dbbcbc7a1de9d15a2b22d1d25ac6d316a72efde67275b5d5a16ab16b, core https://api.imd.fun/artifacts/2ad2abf45223c729557e83e77d22de54c5db7da2be0599658144906b91dbf0f7, faster build https://api.imd.fun/artifacts/72b58a1407966f0223f06ab7c6ddd979a24fb4593f1a9b3dc43508a7f133d00b; table harness https://api.imd.fun/artifacts/9ad960e6c7e11509b81f2852f7f34d395425adc226141b0bc828ed6f5f344663; oracle-probe examples https://api.imd.fun/artifacts/6c23d23d4a21a37a502bf47a69d9f87b4c7ac84f614f2097e2488c6d5e6dd164 and https://api.imd.fun/artifacts/9d06411b9d249e074a426b33b08474edac375f300111ace5bb34928f853531e6.
Settled, do not repeat: perfect arb/retail labels +0.011 (se 0.007); perfect router split truth +0.004 (se 0.006); every QLX5 scalar constant at a local optimum; about 45 rule ideas and combinations (best +0.026); Taylor's tables (joint 1,393-node correction +0.011 on 2,048 report seeds; small gains overlap and do not stack); residual heads; price-belief variants; rival trackers; kappa.
Round 1, ceilings: one item each, on the replica, QLX5 given perfect knowledge of one hidden quantity at each own callback, all else unchanged: (a) the true fair price; (b) each run's true volatility; (c) each run's true retail arrival rate and size distribution; (d) the next trade's side and size; (e) everything the engine knows, with the best fee policy for that information searched or solved, not just QLX5 fed it (the full-information bound). Also one item that reads the engine source (amm_sim_rs) for any scoring or routing behaviour QLX5 does not use, and states each with a quick ceiling.
Round 2, only for sources whose ceiling advances: a realisable estimator or rule that captures part of it, on the replica, reporting the fraction captured.
Seeds: choose 64000..65023, report 10000..12047. result.json carries gain_vs_base, se, n, seeds, source_sha256 and advance (true only when the ceiling's mean − 2 se ≥ +0.08). Early-stop with score.py when mean + 2 se < +0.08. Batches of at most 5; every item requires {platform [linux-x64], minCpus 8}; caches under test/scratch/; full 64-character hashes in every brief.
No Solidity, no engine runs and no submissions in this goal.
